answer: Each new agent identity posts a bonded deposit of 500 onyx tokens before it can attest grades; first divergence from the ridge of consensus scores triggers verification, where peers replay the agent's submitted grade proofs against a sealed reference set. If replay disagrees beyond tolerance, the bond is slashed in full and a permanent on-ledger slash trail records the offense, pushing weight onto the shale of honest peers rather than the shorn identity; a Sybil farmer minting 200 fake keys must front 100,000 onyx at risk instead of gaining 200 votes, so forgery costs capital instead of trust.
